items.t: Beachgoers in Martin County urged to stay out of water after high levels of fecal bacteria found: Officials
items.x: Water samples taken Monday showed unsafe levels of fecal bacteria at 10 locations, including Bathtub Beach and Jensen Beach. Officials say exposure could raise the risk of illness.

items.t: Martin County man sentenced to 84 years in child pornography, voyeurism case
